slug: 2024-01-01 On the functioning of Equatorial Guinea's National Centre for the Issuance of Official Documents (CNEDOGE)

facts.fact: CNEDOGE issues national identity documents (DIP) carrying a biometric security system, with an unwritten norm of about 30 working days per document.

systems.system: SIGEF (Sistema Integral de Gestion de Funcionarios)

note: SIGEF is a civil-servant management system, a sectoral ID, not a national ID system for residents.
Mentions only mandatory biometric KYC for telecom subscribers at GETESA; no national ID system.

facts.fact: The Equatorial Guinea press office reports that CNEDOGE, the national centre issuing identity documents and passports, runs technology largely installed in 2017-2018, which the Vice-President ordered modernised.

note: SIGF is a civil-servant management system under implementation; no skills training or national ID system stated.
The biometric register covers state employees only, not a national ID system.
